title: Convexity of the Fourier square functional
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $c(S)\ge 0$ be a real weight for each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For any real-valued functions $f,g$ on the sign cube and any $\theta\in[0,1]$, the weighted sum of squared Fourier coefficients of $\theta f+(1-\theta)g$ is at most $\theta$ times that of $f$ plus $1-\theta$ times that of $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are real-valued functions on the sign cube
